Definition: Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem, also the name of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ariel is the name Isaiah gives Jerusalem, the lion of God, the city where David dwelt, and God says He will distress Ariel until it is brought low. The same name belongs to a chief man Ezra sends for, one of the leaders he gathers before the journey back to Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name that means lion of God fits a city God chose and then judged: chosen does not mean untouchable. The man who shares the name reminds me that God also calls ordinary leaders by strong names and sends them on hard errands.
